description.value: Tim Hortons is a national Canadian coffee and quick-service chain located on Douglas Street in central Victoria. This location offers dine-in, takeout, and drive-through service, with a menu spanning brewed coffee, baked goods, breakfast wraps, soups, and sandwiches. A touring cyclist passing through would find it a convenient and familiar stop for a quick meal or hot drink.
